title: What the band called Lester; how "Lady Day" caught on
summary: Jones says the band called him Lester while the world said Pres, and recounts how "Lady" and then "Lady Day" spread from the Uptown House.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Did you call him Pres or Lester?
What did the guys in the band call him?
But the world called him Pres.
Called him Pres because Lady Day said, "This is the President," so they just called him Pres.
He took your advice and said there's a lady in the house.

I says "Lady" and..... Then Oh, he laughed, he just cracked up. And every time since they were together, "Come on, Lady." "Lady?" Clark Monroe and all the guys or the boys of the evening used to laugh, "Yes, she is a lady." They said Lady Day and finally Clark Monroe took it up, you know what I mean, and different peoples from there to Mindon's Playhouse and everybody took it up that's as Lady Day. I read in some magazines where he gave the name but they didn't think about it because I said, I'll let them go along with this.
